item.text:
The supplied maps do **not** support a greater vmPFC response with increasing gain in the equal-indifference group. In the pre-specified vmPFC sphere, the mean effect was −0.0057, *t*(53) = −0.43, one-sided *p* = .665; the 95% CI was [−0.0326, 0.0211]. No vmPFC voxel survived whole-brain correction. The corrected whole-brain analysis found 24 voxels in three small posterior occipital foci, outside vmPFC.

The concise report, including methods, uncertainty and limitations, is [report.md](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/workspaces/narps-neutral-r3-08/report.md). Reproducible analysis code is [analysis.py](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/workspaces/narps-neutral-r3-08/analysis/analysis.py). Figures are [the corrected whole-brain map](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/workspaces/narps-neutral-r3-08/figures/whole_brain_fwer_vmPFC.png) and [participant vmPFC estimates](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/workspaces/narps-neutral-r3-08/figures/vmPFC_participant_effects.png); supporting maps and results are in [results/](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/workspaces/narps-neutral-r3-08/results/).

The group test used a one-sided sign-flip max-*t* procedure across common brain coverage. All 54 maps passed checksum and geometry checks; none were excluded. These estimates reflect AO86’s normalized gain modulator, so they do not estimate change per currency unit. A lack of support here is not proof of no effect.
